title: HUD Control
description: Allows you to hide and move HUD elements
body:
**Features**:

Toggle Visibility: Easily hide or show specific parts of the HUD using commands.

Move Elements: Reposition your Hotbar anywhere on the screen using X/Y coordinates.

**Commands**:

/hud toggle hotbar - Hides or shows the Hotbar.

/hud toggle exp - Hides or shows the Experience bar.

/hud move hotbar <x> <y> - Moves the Hotbar to the specified coordinates.

X: Positive moves right, negative moves left.   
Y: Positive moves down, negative moves up.
